description: Reporter-key, control-key and control-SPKI rotation transcripts and signatures.

cases.description: Reporter-key rotation transcript encode('rem-reporter-key-rotation-v1', 12 fields); rotation_digest = SHA-256(transcript); current and proposed keys each sign the transcript with 64-byte low-S IEEE P1363 ECDSA; the HA administrator confirms digest, generation, nonce and expiry over the control channel.

Control-key rotation transcript encode('rem-control-key-rotation-v1', 13 fields) and rotation_digest. Completion carries rem (current key) and rem-proposed (proposed key) RFC 9421 signatures with identical components and parameters except keyid. Transcript mutations are rejected by the core's durable challenge comparison (409); malformed transport fields retain route/profile precedence, and signature binding mutations fail before business logic (401). An exact duplicate before expiry returns the recorded result; replay after expiry and cross-route or cross-purpose rebinding fail authentication.

Planned control TLS SPKI transition encode('rem-control-spki-rotation-v1', 12 fields). The old and new control TLS keys each sign the transcript (64-byte low-S P1363); the integration checks SHA-256(old_spki_der) equals its pin and SHA-256(new_spki_der) equals new_spki_sha256, verifies both signatures, obtains HA administrator confirmation and sends confirm only on a connection whose leaf SPKI equals new_spki_sha256 within the ten-minute overlap.
